posts.text: It was an honour to be at S:/HACKS 2026 and a bigger one to be there with my team. Thirty students picked from hundreds of applicants, eight teams, thirteen hours on a case and ours won first place. If I can be blunt, this was one of the best-run hackathons I've been to and the people I worked with made it better still.
